name: Apex Vibes
description: 🎶 Premium Telegram Music Bot — YouTube streaming, AutoPlay, Lyrics, Colored Controls

MONGO_DB_URI.description: NEW/live MongoDB Atlas URI for this Apex Vibes bot (mongodb+srv://...)

STRING_SESSION.description: Pyrogram string session of assistant/userbot account

OWNER_NAME.description: Alias shown in play cards (e.g. Maestro) — NOT your real name

LOG_GROUP_ID.description: Private Telegram group ID for error logs (e.g. -1001234567890). Must be a group where YOUR bot is an admin -- do not reuse an example/old ID.

GENIUS_API_TOKEN.description: Genius API token from genius.com/api-clients (for lyrics)

YT_COOKIES.description: Paste the raw contents of a cookies.txt exported from a browser logged into youtube.com (Netscape format). Base64 also accepted. Strongly recommended on Heroku to avoid bot-detection blocks.

ALT_SOURCE.description: 1 = when YouTube blocks the server, play the same song from JioSaavn/SoundCloud instead of failing. 0 = disable.

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: YouTube Data API v3 key — makes song search/metadata resolve in ~0.3s instead of several seconds. Comma-separate multiple keys to auto-rotate on quota.

VIDEO_QUALITY.description: Video quality for /vplay (720p is the stable default; 1080p/480p/360p supported)

PLAY_PROBE_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds allowed for direct CDN handoff before fallback download

PLAY_STARTUP_DEADLINE.description: Hard total playback startup budget in seconds (8-30)

DIRECT_STREAM.description: Prefer direct CDN streaming; set false to force the download fallback

DIRECT_VIDEO_STREAM.description: Stream YouTube video directly; required for multi-gigabyte movies

VIDEO_FALLBACK_MAX_SECONDS.description: Maximum video duration allowed for full-file fallback; 0 disables it

EARLY_AUDIO_HANDOFF.description: Unsafe growing-file handoff; keep false on cloud hosts

TG_PROXY_CACHE_MB.description: Global RAM budget for Telegram large-media range proxy cache

TG_PROXY_CONCURRENCY.description: Maximum simultaneous Telegram range-body streams per worker

MUSIC_ONLY_MODE.description: Load only music handlers to reduce startup/RAM (true/false)

PLAYBACK_RECOVERY.description: Rejoin old voice chats after restart; keep false for fastest safe startup

MONGO_GRIDFS_CACHE.description: Optional secondary GridFS upload cache; keep false on small Heroku dynos

SOURCE_CODE_URL.description: Optional public repository URL for the Source Code button. Leave empty to keep this build private.

MEM_SOFT_LIMIT_MB.description: RSS (MB) above which the memory watchdog trims freed memory back to the OS. Leave empty to auto-derive ~80% of the dyno quota.

COOKIES_URL.description: Auto-refresh YouTube cookies from GitHub Gist (redeploy not needed)

ENABLE_WARP.description: Start Cloudflare WARP-plus proxy on boot
